items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: I knew Happy. I met him when I first come here.

ctx.x: loud-mouthed guy, you know. But he was all right.
Happy Caldwell told me he used to always have a crowd around him and...
Oh, he would always have a crowd.

items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: Then Charlie Holmes called me. He said, Hap, did you catch Hawk.

ctx.x: -- stay home, catch Hawk. So when they came on, he didn't come on. But -- well, this is funny. He didn't show. So next night I didn't bother to look at television that much. Then Charlie Holmes called me. He said, Hap, did you catch Hawk. I said, I tried to catch

him two nights before, but he was scheduled to appear and didn't. He said, well, perhaps you should be glad you didn't catch him. I said, why, Charlie? He said, man, you wouldn't know him. Said, he came out there, and said, his whiskers was way down to his navel, said, looked like old man of the mountains. I said, Charlie, you got to be kidding. Says, no, Hap. Looked like old man of the mountains.
